description: Optimize the geometry of a nitric oxide molecule in its doublet ground state.
user_prompt: Optimize the geometry of a nitric oxide molecule, then report the final energy and N-O bond length.

method.modeling: Gas-phase NO molecule in its doublet ground state, in a cubic box with at least 12 Angstrom vacuum separation.
method.rationale: The target N-O bond length is the PAW/PBE value reported by Han (2022) for the doublet NO ground state. The reference uses a 600 eV cutoff and a 23 x 22 x 21 Angstrom molecular cell. Only the N-O bond length is scored because the absolute molecular total energy is sensitive to PAW dataset, cell conventions, and spin setup. The +/-0.02 Angstrom tolerance covers ordinary PAW/PBE setup and relaxation-threshold differences.
